protocol.purpose: Test whether automation click-command duration tracks controlled synchronous processing, asynchronous task completion, and pre-action readiness. This is instrument characterization, not a participant study or website recollection.
protocol.cache_state: fresh context per observation; local fixture has no external assets
protocol.warmup: one separately logged sync-0 observation excluded from the 96 experimental observations
protocol.ordering: condition order shuffled within each block with a fixed-seed linear congruential generator

endpoints.command_duration_ms: Node monotonic elapsed time around Playwright locator.click; null if command fails
endpoints.page_response_ms: page performance.now difference from trusted click-handler entry to DOM result update; null without result
endpoints.task_completion_duration_ms: Node monotonic time from click-command invocation through observed completion predicate; null without completion
endpoints.event_durations_ms: raw PerformanceEventTiming durations, when supported; not aggregated or labeled as INP

protocol.analysis: Report all observations, per-condition medians and empirical ranges, and asynchronous underestimation. No population inference, parameter fitting, outlier deletion, or participant claims.
protocol.stopping_rule: 12 complete blocks plus 3 observations per failure condition; preserve every exception; do not replace failed runs
protocol.limitations: One browser, machine, viewport and session; known-delay fixtures; requestAnimationFrame observation is not a paint timestamp; timer targets are minimum delays, not exact elapsed-time ground truth; no evidence about perceived usability.
